data.value: IRunninghill ayigqibanga ukulayisha. Layisha iphepha kwakhona. Ukuba oku kuyaqhubeka, zama ifestile yabucala yesikhangeli uze wabelane ngeenkcukacha zokuxilonga nenkxaso.

data.value: Ifayile efunekayo kweli phepha ayilayishekanga. Jonga uqhagamshelo lwakho uze ulayishe kwakhona. Ukuba kuyaqhubeka, yabelana ngegama lefayile neenkcukacha zokuxilonga nenkxaso.

data.value: Ithokheni ihlala kwimemori. Amanani ewonke afuna words.read ne-sentences.read; iilog zenkonzo zifuna logs.read; iimvavanyo zomthwalo zifuna status.read.

data.value: Vala uze uvule ibhodi kwakhona. Yabelana ngekhowudi yempazamo nohlobo lwempazamo nenkxaso. Jonga ifayile yesatifikethi ukuba ikhona elungiselelweyo.

data.name: Text_fec8d8da75de
data.value: Isatifikethi se-HTTPS asikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa; ithokheni ayikajongwa. Kwi-localhost, seta RUNNINGHILL_DASHBOARD_CA_CERT kumendo opheleleyo we-.run/tls/localhost.crt uze uvule kwakhona ideshibhodi. Ukuba sele isetiwe, jonga ukuba i-nginx isebenzisa eso satifikethi nokuba igama lomamkeli nemihla yaso zisemthethweni. Ikhowudi yempazamo: HttpRequestError.SecureConnectionError.
